replace:
const versusUnlockAtBuild = opts.versusUnlock?.() ?? EVERY_BOARD_UNLOCKED;
  const versusUnlock = (): BoardUnlock => versusUnlockAtBuild;
killedBy: hud: versus setup pane (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-21-versus-setup-menu-design.md) shows only the boards this save has unlocked, re-read on every open (issue #983)
hud: versus setup pane (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-21-versus-setup-menu-design.md) drops a selected board that a progress reset locked, on the next open, seeded or not (issue #983)
hud: versus setup pane (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-21-versus-setup-menu-design.md) an axis change drops a held board the save no longer unlocks, and says only that it is gone (issue #983)
why: Reads the unlock once, when the HUD is built, instead of on every row build. The page's HUD outlives every session, so a level cleared after boot would not reach the versus Map row until a reload, and a progress reset would leave its boards offered for the rest of the page. A tidy-looking hoist of a getter that is 'only progress', which is exactly why `HudOptions.versusUnlock` is a getter. Proved before its tests existed, by hand: the pre-#983 test file passed 0 failed of 134 with this mutation applied; then KILLED by 3 of 137, measured.
